summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K on August 17, 2026, disclosing a routine share repurchase under its previously announced buyback program. The company repurchased 115,000 ordinary shares (0.01% of issued capital) on Euronext Paris between August 10-14, 2026, at a weighted average price of EUR 47.9854 per share, totaling EUR 5,518,320.50. The repurchases were executed by a broker to meet obligations from employee share option programs. Following the transactions, STMicroelectronics holds 18,828,440 treasury shares, approximately 2.1% of issued capital. This is a routine periodic disclosure with no special-situation characteristics.
